dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Thank you for calling CityNet customer service. My name is Kevin. How can I help you today?
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋk juː fər ˈkɔːlɪŋ ˈsɪti ˌnɛt ˈkʌstəmər ˈsɜːrvɪs. maɪ ˈneɪm ɪz ˈkɛvɪn. ˈhaʊ kən aɪ ˈhɛlp juː təˈdeɪ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Hi, Kevin. I'm so happy to speak to a real agent! I waited for twenty minutes.
dialogue.reading: ˈhaɪ, ˈkɛvɪn. aɪm soʊ ˈhæpi tə ˈspiːk tə ə ˈriːəl ˈeɪdʒənt! aɪ ˈweɪtɪd fər ˈtwɛnti ˈmɪnɪts.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: I'm sorry about the wait. Do you mind if I record this call? It's company policy.
dialogue.reading: aɪm ˈsɑːri əˈbaʊt ðə ˈweɪt. duː juː ˈmaɪnd ɪf aɪ rɪˈkɔːrd ðɪs ˈkɔːl? ɪts ˈkʌmpəni ˈpɑːləsi.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No, I don't mind. My home internet hasn't worked for two days.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, aɪ ˈdoʊnt ˈmaɪnd. maɪ ˈhoʊm ˈɪntərnɛt ˈhæzənt ˈwɜːrkt fər ˈtuː ˈdeɪz.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Could I have your account number, please?
dialogue.reading: aɪm ˈsɑːri tə ˈhɪr ˈðæt. kʊd aɪ ˈhæv jʊr əˈkaʊnt ˌnʌmbər, ˈpliːz?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Sure. It's four, five, seven, two, nine, one.
dialogue.reading: ˈʃʊr. ɪts ˈfɔːr, ˈfaɪv, ˈsɛvən, ˈtuː, ˈnaɪn, ˈwʌn.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Thank you. Now I just need to ask you a security question. What city were you born in?
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋk juː. ˈnaʊ aɪ ˈdʒʌst ˈniːd tə ˈæsk juː ə sɪˈkjʊrəti ˌkwɛstʃən. ˈwʌt ˈsɪti wɜːr juː ˈbɔːrn ˈɪn?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: That's correct. Would you mind if I checked your line now? It'll only take a minute.
dialogue.reading: ðæts kəˈrɛkt. wʊd juː ˈmaɪnd ɪf aɪ ˈtʃɛkt jʊr ˈlaɪn ˈnaʊ? ɪtəl ˈoʊnli ˈteɪk ə ˈmɪnɪt.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: OK. I can see a problem with the lines in your neighborhood.
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. aɪ kən ˈsiː ə ˈprɑːbləm wɪð ðə ˈlaɪnz ɪn jʊr ˈneɪbərhʊd.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Oh no. Do you mind if I ask how long it will take to fix?
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ ˈnoʊ. duː juː ˈmaɪnd ɪf aɪ ˈæsk ˈhaʊ ˈlɔːŋ ɪt wɪl ˈteɪk tə ˈfɪks?
